title: Strong Towns | Charles Marohn | Talks at Google
summary: Charles Marohn of Strong Towns presents, in a Talks at Google session, the ideas from his book on why many North American towns struggle financially despite decades of growth. He argues for incremental, bottom-up city building as a path to local prosperity.
why: HN commenters link it in housing and urbanism threads as a clear explanation of unsustainable car-oriented development and fragile systems.

quote.text: It has a great explanation of the difference between complex and complicated
